source_message:
feat(governance): G-21 Claude Code hooks — 4 hooks + settings.json (30/30 tests, suite 324/324)

Implements GAP-REGISTER G-21: vibe-coding governance via Claude Code hooks.
Prevents accidental policy-layer modifications and enforces architectural boundaries.

── .claude/settings.json ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Project-level hook configuration (committed — applies to all Claude Code sessions
in this repo).  Uses absolute paths to be CWD-independent.

  PreToolUse  → Edit|Write  → policy_guard.py      (CLASS_B/C file guard)
  PostToolUse → Edit|Write  → invariant_check.py   (I-22/I-24/I-25 scan)
                            → bounded_context_check.py  (G-18 import rules)
  UserPromptSubmit          → load_architecture.py (arch context on relevant queries)

── .claude/hooks/policy_guard.py  (PreToolUse — BLOCKS) ─────────────────────
Reads tool_input.file_path from stdin JSON.
Matches against CLASS_B and CLASS_C patterns from change_classes.yaml (G-05):

CLASS_C (MLRO|CEO required — exit 2):
  compliance_config.yaml, banxe_compliance.rego, any .rego file

CLASS_B (DEVELOPER|CTIO|CEO required — exit 2):
  SOUL.md, SOUL-*.md, IDENTITY.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, openclaw.json

Allowed: all other files → exit 0, silent
Bypass: GOVERNANCE_BYPASS=1 env var for protect-soul.sh / emergency use
Output: actionable message with exact governance path command

── .claude/hooks/invariant_check.py  (PostToolUse — warns only) ─────────────
Fires on compliance/ and developer/ file edits.
Inline invariant rules (no Semgrep required):
  I-22: PolicyPort write method detection
  I-24: DecisionEvent field mutation after creation
  I-25: result.explanation = None in orchestrator
  I-21: Hardcoded threshold numbers instead of config_loader
Optional Semgrep integration when .semgrep/banxe-rules.yml present.
Always exit 0 (warn, never blocks).

── .claude/hooks/bounded_context_check.py  (PostToolUse — warns only) ───────
Fires on all .py edits.  Checks 5 boundary rules:
  BC-01: agents/ must not import engine modules directly (use Ports)
  BC-02: event_sourcing/ must not import banxe_aml_orchestrator
  BC-03: governance/ must not import from agents/ (cross-cutting concern)
  BC-04: test files must use InMemoryAuditAdapter, not Postgres
  BC-05: Fan-out detector — warns if a module imports from ≥4 sub-packages
Always exit 0 (warn, never blocks).

── .claude/hooks/load_architecture.py  (UserPromptSubmit — silent by default) ─
Fires on every user message; outputs one-line summary ONLY when prompt
contains architecture keywords (gap, invariant, cqrs, bounded context, etc.):
  [BANXE ARCH] Suite: 324 tests ✓ | Gaps P1: 8 DONE / 0 OPEN | Hooks: G-21 active | Sprint P2
Silent on non-architecture queries — minimal noise.

Tests: test_hooks.py T-01..T-30 — 30 passed
  T-01..T-05: settings.json structure + all 4 scripts exist + valid syntax
  T-06..T-17: policy_guard (SOUL blocked, AGENTS allowed, CLASS_C, bypass, governance path)
  T-18..T-20: invariant_check (non-compliance silent, malformed JSON fail-open)
  T-21..T-26: bounded_context_check (BC-01..BC-04 + clean file silent)
  T-27..T-30: load_architecture (unrelated silent, gap/invariant/architecture → summary)

Full suite: 324/324 passed
